title: The orthodox Sunni Sufi
summary: Lewisohn's article studies the apologies, and on Melvin-Koushki's report takes them at face value: a Shāfiʿī qadi and Ashʿarī by creed for whom Sufism is the discipline of the Sunni elite, driven from office by envious enemies. Lewisohn's own text was not read by the researchers; the phases follow how the apologies tell the life, and are the periodisation this reading needs, not his.
